cards.title: Rhythm & tempo
cards.result: A frozen direct-tempo method is wired in the local application. The 151-case saved comparison reports 13 combined failures (8.61%), including two missing and two severe; the older baseline has 62/151 combined failures.
cards.limit: Training-exposed development evidence; broad transfer remains open. Local implementation is not a hosted release or broad independent validation.
cards.next: Admit rights-cleared, independent and diverse references; verify full release/hosted behavior before claiming broad deployment.

cards.title: Chords & harmony
cards.result: Private opt-in BTC: triad recording failures 4/7 → 3/7; severe 1/7 unchanged, no missing/invalid outputs. Seven-pair duration errors: root 25.04% → 19.84%, triad 31.57% → 27.50%, full quality 47.40% → 39.18%. Actual-app off/on checks completed.
cards.limit: Root, strict-triad and full-quality are distinct; the below-30% failure goal is unmet. Exposed development evidence and noncommercial/source-rights limits preclude broad or commercial claims.
cards.next: Seek lawful, independent diverse confirmation; retain the completed private opt-in and unchanged ordinary default. Any new integration needs renewed authorization and actual-app checks.

cards.title: Instrument presence
cards.result: Saved PaSST/fusion comparator: 55/292 recordings above 30% known-label error; 12 severe, no missing outputs. This is not the installed presence default. PANNs worsened failures 55 → 133/292; partial YourMT3 worsened 29 → 38/122 matched recordings.
cards.limit: Sparse labels and exposed development, not broad independent or full-inventory accuracy. YourMT3 also had 22 invalid and 149 missing outputs in its intended 295; its matched subset is not a full-cohort result.
cards.next: Require independently labeled, rights-cleared and diverse examples; test full-track aggregation before any separately authorized adoption.

cards.title: Lead vs accompaniment
cards.result: Original frozen gate: vocal-specialist candidate 5/6 vs 4/6 for both controls. Post-hoc always-Vocal counterfactual also 5/6; voice-component value unproven on this Vocal-heavy set.
cards.limit: Eight valid capped outputs; two non-primary cases excluded. No reliability gain or abstention claim. Prior exposure/unknown overlap; broad validation and app adoption deferred.
cards.next: Next prerequisite: separately approved, varied comparison against the always-Vocal rule. No automatic expansion or app integration.
cards.status: Small screen passed; specialist-specific benefit unproven

overall.summary: Four distinct recognizer tasks; this small lead confirmation clears its frozen promise gate, but broad independent validation and application adoption remain unestablished. Chord private opt-in integration exists; lead remains unchanged.
limitations: Endpoints and denominators are task-specific; do not combine duration error, recording-failure incidence, role ranking or predominance.
Unknown or unannotated classes are not negatives. Rights, checkpoint exposure and independent reference quality constrain transfer.
No general production-readiness, hosted-release, commercial-rights, or broad-accuracy claim follows from these results.
